name: 忽幽狸
description: 忽幽狸的尾巴覆盖着剧毒尖刺，静止时会伪装成灌木枝条。当感知到危险，尾巴会瞬间硬化成防御姿态，刺尖分泌的神经毒素能使猎物肌肉僵直。检测显示，其毒素对草系精灵效果加倍。
descriptionEn: Huyouli's tail is covered with venomous spikes and, when still, disguises itself as a bush branch. When sensing danger, the tail instantly hardens into a defensive posture; the neurotoxin secreted from its tip can stiffen a prey's muscles. Tests show its toxin is doubly effective against Grass-type creatures.
